column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a myriad” is not rendered, and “you came to the finest ornaments” is rendered “became very beautiful.”
Close to the Hebrew; a leather of uncertain kind, is rendered “badger skin.”
The end of the verse is obscure in Hebrew; the meaning is uncertain. NKJV renders “Such things should not happen, nor be.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a soothing aroma” is rendered “sweet incense.”
